name: Egypt
hook: Cleopatra, the Nile and the gods: the handful of Egyptian answers Jeopardy keeps returning to.

facts.label: the Nile
facts.statement: The Nile is Egypt's lifeline: the Romans founded Antinoopolis after Antinous drowned in it, and Isis's temple in Pompeii imported its holy water.

facts.label: Cleopatra
facts.statement: Cleopatra was Egypt's last pharaoh. After her death in 30 B.C., Egypt became a province of the Roman Empire.

facts.label: Alexandria
facts.statement: Alexandria was Egypt's capital for nearly a thousand years and a center of learning; Hypatia taught there before her murder.

facts.label: Isis and Osiris
facts.statement: Isis was Osiris's sister and consort and Horus's mother; Set murdered Osiris, who then became ruler of the underworld.

facts.label: Nefertiti
facts.statement: Nefertiti was Akhenaten's queen; the painted bust found at Amarna in 1912 made her a symbol of beauty.

facts.label: Memphis
facts.statement: Memphis was an ancient capital of Egypt and a center of worship of Ptah; the Bible calls it Noph.

facts.label: Anwar Sadat
facts.statement: Anwar Sadat signed the 1979 peace treaty with Israel and was assassinated in 1981.
